s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 分配背景故事出错：
[DND边缘大陆] 背景特性联动出错：
（1.46.0）新生成的小人按兵种、种族、派系换上费伦的童年和成年背景（139 条）。只影响之后新生成的小人，已有的小人不变。关闭后完全按原版分配。
s.en: (1.46.0) Newly generated pawns get Faerûn childhood and adulthood backstories by pawn kind, race and faction (139 of them). Only affects pawns generated afterwards; existing pawns are unchanged. When off, assignment is fully vanilla.

s.zh: %（DND 种族的小人每个背景槽位换成本族背景的概率）
s.en: % (chance for each backstory slot of a DND-race pawn to be replaced with a backstory of its own race)

s.zh: %（不属于 DND 派系的原版人类，包括开局殖民者，每个背景槽位换成费伦背景的概率）
s.en: % (chance for each backstory slot of vanilla humans not in a DND faction, including starting colonists, to be replaced with a Faerûn backstory)
